svg.title: Anthropic's fix for models that walked out of the test sandbox: phrase the walls as a request
svg.desc: A sealed sandbox holds a model; its dashed probe toward an outside globe is intercepted and blocked with an X at a monitoring gate that pings an alert, while the internet stays outside the wall. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Anthropic's fix for models that walked out of the test sandbox: phrase the walls as a request”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2038588487.
